title.narrative: Lifesaving response to El Nino projected communities in Luuq district, Gedo through unconditional cash transfer

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 12pt"gtThe initiative is a response to Reserve Allocation 5 from the Somali Humanitarian Fund in 2023, aimed at supporting communities affected by El Nino. The objective is to provide immediate assistance to vulnerable households at risk of negative outcomes due to El Nino. The intervention will focus on 1125 households, which will receive an unconditional cash transfer of USD 80 monthly for three months. The households include 750 men, 1350 women, 2650 girls, and 2000 boys, including those with disabilities. The project's primary goal is to provide food access to all genders, ages, and minority groups, focusing on riverine households and those with disabilities. Transferring funds through mobile money will reduce negative coping mechanisms for the targeted households. HoD is already implementing food security project funded by FAO. The SHF project will entirely target different locations and new beneficiarieslt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gtTo ensure gender and protection integration, beneficiary information will be disaggregated by age, gender, and sex. The beneficiaries will be selected transparently and fairly, prioritising the most vulnerable. The community will be mobilised on how to claim their rights effectively. They will have access to a hotline number to register their complaints, suggestions, or compliments about the project. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gtThe cash transfer method was chosen due to its speed and effectiveness during crises. It also gives affected populations the freedom to decide how to use the money, which improves their choices and dignity. The RA5 food security project will be integrated with other clusters such as WASH, health, protection and NFI shelter through joint meetings and beneficiaries. The project activities will commence in late October with mobilizations and the formation of relief committees. Registration of beneficiaries will be completed in late November. The proposed project will prioritise the following activities in order: lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt1. Raising awareness and mobilizing project stakeholders from the district to the community level.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt2. Registering and validating 1125 households through fair and inclusive selection criteria.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt3. Transfer cash using local mobile money operators, targeting the 1125 households.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt4. Conducting three post-distribution monitoring and one final project monitoring exercise.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gtThe project target villages include Kulun, Xero Kobaad, Godob, Taleex, Banmadule, Sullale, Luuq Goday, Gumurco, Caracase, and Hanooy. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gtAs the humanitarian environment in Somalia is fragile, the following measures will be taken to prevent any form of corruption or fraud that would deprive vulnerable populations in Luuq of their right to access aid:lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt1. Emphasizing mobilization to ensure all beneficiaries and the community understand the project's details.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt2. Developing selection criteria prioritizing the most deserving households in consultation with the local community.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt3. Employing robust verification during registration by visiting each household to ensure they meet the criteria.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt4. Posting banners and posters with project details, including the number of households per village, at each village.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt5. Publicly announcing the names of selected beneficiaries per village to ensure transparency.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptline-height:107%font-family:"gt6. Producing monthly CARM reports to ensure timely review and response to beneficiary and community feedback by the HoD.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
